findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: restaurantdoctor_get_questions, restaurantdoctor_deadlines, restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge · Private data: restaurantdoctor_fica_tip_credit, restaurantdoctor_card_fees · Public sink: restaurantdoctor_deadlines, restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_prime_cost, restaurantdoctor_labor_cost, restaurantdoctor_restaurant_budget, restaurantdoctor_booking_fees, restaurantdoctor_cash_out, restaurantdoctor_tip_out · Destructive: restaurantdoctor_run_free_check, restaurantdoctor_cost_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: restaurantdoctor_get_questions, restaurantdoctor_deadlines, restaurantdoctor_search_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge · Private data: restaurantdoctor_fica_tip_credit, restaurantdoctor_card_fees · Public sink: restaurantdoctor_deadlines, restaurantdoctor_list_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_read_knowledge, restaurantdoctor_prime_cost, restaurantdoctor_labor_cost, restaurantdoctor_restaurant_budget, restaurantdoctor_booking_fees, restaurantdoctor_cash_out, restaurantdoctor_tip_out · Destructive: restaurantdoctor_run_free_check, restaurantdoctor_cost_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
